// diagnostic

E2425

Function `{function}` promises `Never` but returns a value.

What

Function `{function}` promises `Never` but returns a value.

Why

A declared `Never` return has no success value (D-NEVER2=B).

Fix

Remove the value and diverge, or change the return type.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E2425: tests/ui/never_return_value.stderr.
